title: Jet Admin Cloud prompt injection can disclose configuration credentials
summary: A remote attacker with a free account can use prompt injection to retrieve .env files and credentials. The CVE reports mitigation through a sandbox component around October 29, 2026.

severity.rationale: Credential disclosure warrants a 72-hour response. A free account is an accessible prerequisite; the reported mitigation needs confirmation for the hosted service.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted from directly inspected primary sources for independent review.

affected.note: CVE lists all versions of this hosted service; no fixed version is specified.

exposure: The documented attack requires a free account. The published vectors say PR:N, but the description explicitly requires an account.

params.instructions: Check use of Jet Admin Cloud Platform and ask the provider to confirm the sandbox mitigation for CVE-2026-123965.

remediation.details: Confirm the reported sandbox mitigation with Jet Admin; no client upgrade version is specified.
remediation.risk: Provider confirmation may be needed before restoring sensitive workflows.

verification: Obtain provider confirmation that the sandbox mitigation covers the service in use.
